name: A New Year in Auckland 2024

venue.name: Te Atatu Peninsula Community Centre
venue.address: 595 Te Atatū Road,  Te Atatū Peninsula

information: A New Year in Auckland 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
